notes.title: Pre-Alpha Gameplay Trailer Released
notes.content:
Unveiling Early Development Gameplay | The Darkened Halls

🌑 Prepare to step into the shadows with the first-ever gameplay trailer for 'The Darkened Halls.' Join me, a solo developer, on a spine-chilling journey through a world of mystery, puzzles, and nightmarish creatures.

🔗 Watch the Trailer: 
[previewyoutube=iJ9xQxsb0BY;full][/previewyoutube]

🕹️ Gameplay Highlights:

Encounter nightmarish bosses in a psychological horror experience.
Solve intricate puzzles and uncover chilling secrets.
Face your fears armed with wits, not weapons.
Witness the relentless pursuit of formidable foes.
📢 Note: This is early development footage, and 'The Darkened Halls' is a work in progress. Your feedback is crucial as I shape the final experience.

🌟 Thank you for your support! Subscribe to stay updated on the journey through the darkened halls.
